mapper.select:
select basi.acct_subject_id id, basi.acct_subject_name text from BOK_BOOKSET BB LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO basi ON BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = basi.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND basi.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE where 1=1 AND BB.bookset_type != #{BOOKSET_TYPE_TEMPLATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (basi.acct_subject_id like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR basi.acct_subject_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

update.foreach: update SZT_INTERF_VALUATION set REMARK = #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CHECK_STATUS = #{item.checkStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_USER = #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where SERIALNO = #{item.serialNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
